summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (May 2026) with embedded firmware experience across STM32 Cortex-M platforms, FreeRTOS, and serial protocols (UART, SPI, I2C). Developed bare-metal C firmware for timer-driven ADC sampling, interrupt-driven peripherals, and hardware-software integration validated with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers; experienced in PCB design, Git-based version control, and GUI tools for laboratory data acquisition.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi Pico and HC-05 Bluetooth; translated 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands using UART/I2C peripheral communication.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and ADC resolution tuning, verified with oscilloscope.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented closed-loop sensor feedback over UART and I2C communication protocols.
Led 25-member team across national-level competitions, owning embedded firmware development, PCB fabrication, and hardware-software integration end-to-end.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Developed a PyQt + Matplotlib GUI for real-time data acquisition and visualization in a laboratory instrumentation environment.
Used GitLab for version control and maintained technical documentation and collaborative analysis workflows on JupyterHub.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret — STM32 + FreeRTOS
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM control on STM32 with interrupt-driven UART command reception; used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination across concurrent control loops.
Integrated VL53L0X ToF sensor over I2C and OLED display; processed real-time detection commands from NVIDIA Jetson over UART.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built Cortex-M4 firmware in bare-metal C with timer-synchronized ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C display driver; programmed GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1 directly.
Achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at deterministic 1 Hz update rate; verified peripheral and timing behavior in Proteus simulation.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Robotic Arm (COFFIN) — MS Capstone, RIT
bullets: Integrated TCA9548A I2C multiplexer with dual VL53L0X ToF sensors for contact-aware grasping; drove five servos from Arduino via UART commands from an edge server.
Resolved 11 HW-SW integration failures (servo crosstalk, sensor false positives); achieved 100% pick reliability (10/10 trials) at ~11.5s end-to-end latency.

awards: 1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
